title: Data Lineage and Stewardship Along a Pipeline
description: Trace a field from CRM to executive report and see which two stages a named data steward is accountable for.
creator: Systems Thinking in the Age of AI
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Systems Thinking in the Age of AI
Data Management and Governance

educational.learningObjective: Given a field's path from source system to report, the learner will trace its data lineage and identify which stage a named data steward is accountable for.
prerequisites: Knows what a data pipeline is
Has seen a report whose numbers were disputed
learningOutcomes: Trace a field's lineage from source to report
Identify which stages a named steward is accountable for
Explain why unstewarded stages are where governance fails
educational.assessmentOpportunity: Give learners a disputed figure and ask which stage they would investigate first, and who they would ask.

pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click-to-inspect chain with a full-path trace button
pedagogical.instructionalStrategy: Two overlaid concepts (lineage and stewardship) on one diagram
pedagogical.feedbackType: A per-stage explanation plus a generated full-path statement
misconceptionsAddressed: That lineage and stewardship are the same thing
That a data steward owns the data rather than its meaning
discussionQuestions: Why is stewardship about meaning rather than about servers?
What makes the source system so hard to steward?
Should the person who reads a number be accountable for it?
